verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report says kitty works with a zsh/tmux setup, but only "after a few tweaks", so running tmux inside kitty is plausible yet thinly evidenced. Nothing in the pack documents a native tmux integration or control mode; kitty's own tabs, splits and layouts are an alternative to tmux, not tmux support. missing for 10: first-party documentation of tmux compatibility or configuration, any native tmux integration/control mode, and more than one anecdotal report (including what the needed tweaks are).
